design:
## Design tests

Revision 35 was read blind in whole test scenes among other events (`vision/design_tests_v037.md`, six pictures, six readers). Two of them are v0.36's pictures 73 and 63 rebuilt on their own seeds, the pictures that asked for the knob and dustpan rules. On picture 73's seed the sweeper by the gate is a "boy with dark skin and short black hair", and in every garden test whose reader names it the knob is the gate's ("a diagonal brace and a round dark knob"). The three storm pointers read at the clouds with no clothesline in the picture, two with the tree offered as a second reading, and nobody stands on a heap or a dustpan. The street's crate, set nearer the viewer, is "a random box left on the pavement" or "spare stock", with no word of the stall's leg.
intro:
The thirty-fourth screen read all 82 pictures, the set's 21 and 61 probes: 870 of 876 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The sweeper by the gate, read as a woman with a bun in three screens, is "a boy with short dark hair, a green shirt and khaki trousers", no storm pointer stands on a dustpan or points at a line, and no reader mentions the stall's leg. 63 of 64 templates pass. The one failure is `hang_laundry`, on a picture identical to v0.36's, where it had full marks: one reader could not tell whether the washing was being hung up or taken down, as one did in v0.30 and v0.31, and the template has one scored item a picture. v0.31's list held a fix for that, a basket at the hanger's feet, and it heads v0.38's.

This screen is a retest too: 75 pictures were identical to v0.36's, and 775 of their 783 items scored the same.
screen:
Across all 82 pictures 870 of 876 scored items had full marks, and none was misread. The three scorers gave four, one and one items under full marks, in 304, 283 and 289, each a half mark. Each of the six had full marks on the same seed in v0.36, five of them on pictures identical to the pixel and the sixth, the bird by the sandwich, on the street isomorph changed by the crate alone; in the tier-4 park the duck coming for the bread went up as the girl throwing it went down. The set's headline is all items 0.993 (0.996 in v0.36), with things at 1.00, actions at 0.996, inferences at 0.971 and contradictions at 0.977, the upward water half explained in the tier-4 street, and every reader named the clouds.

**An eighth retest.** 75 pictures, 16 of the set's and 59 probes, were identical to the pixel in v0.36 and v0.37. 775 of their 783 items scored the same; three moved up and five down, every one by half a mark, and one of the five is the gate's one failure.

**Remarks were 2.82 a picture, 231 on 82 pictures**, from 1.89 to 4.44 a reader. On the 75 identical pictures they fell from 226 to 209. The scorers' lists hold one new kind: the broom's autumn leaves under green trees, "a small seasonal inconsistency", four times, three from the reader who wrote most, on pictures identical to v0.36's, where no reader had remarked on them. A storm pointer on a picture unchanged since v0.35 was offered the cat on the fence a third screen running ("or up at the cat or something on the fence").
redrawn: No template here was redrawn: revision 35 moved where things go. `sweep_fork`, `sweep` and `rain_coming` hold at 1.00, the two pictures the rules were written for changed, and the others not at all.
gate: Every template was screened in at least three pictures (52 in three, 4 in four, 4 in five, 2 in six and 2 in eleven), and 63 of 64 pass, as in v0.35. The one failure, `hang_laundry` (0.833), rests on three items, one a picture. The lowest of those that pass are `ducks_bread` and `water_upward` (0.944), each on one half mark. The gate is a filter, and the pilot with people is the test of difficulty.
inspection: All four tier-4 cells placed on v0.36's seeds under revision 35, the street's on v0.29 to v0.36's forced set, and all four came back identical to the pixel. 16 of the set's 21 pictures came back identical to v0.36's, and the other five, the street pictures with the spare crate, differ by the crate alone, in a box some 86 by 123 px. The tier-4 isomorph took 12 failed attempts, as in v0.33 to v0.36. 59 of the 61 probes came back identical, the two that did not being the two the rules were written for. The first probe pass left `walk_dog`, `dog_begs` and `windy_hat` short, as in v0.36, and two more probes filled them, the street's on v0.36's seed. All 82 records rebuild identical to the pixel, and the library passes the validator in full, 344 of 344.
calib: No field of the calibration moved by 0.002 or more, so the priors are v0.36's.
